label: Hypospadias
reason: Male-only and not prenatally diagnosable; there is no detection-and-termination channel at all. The strongest available control.

label: Cleft palate alone
reason: Poorly detectable on routine prenatal ultrasound because the secondary palate is obscured; termination for isolated cleft palate is essentially unrecorded in the US.

label: Cleft lip with or without cleft palate
reason: Detectable prenatally from the second trimester but isolated cleft lip is essentially never terminated in the US.

label: Limb reduction defect
reason: Detectable prenatally; termination is rare and confined to severe multi-limb cases.

label: Gastroschisis
reason: Has no material reduction channel and would otherwise qualify as a control. Excluded because its true US birth prevalence is genuinely falling after a long rise: its composition-adjusted recorded rate falls 26.0% over 2016-2018 to 2022-2024. Attributing that to recording would be wrong.

label: Cyanotic congenital heart disease
reason: Ascertainment changed independently of the shared item: universal newborn pulse-oximetry screening was phased in across the states over 2011-2018. Its composition-adjusted recorded rate rose 14.5% over 2016-2018 to 2022-2024 while every control fell. Retained as a named negative control rather than dropped silently.

label: Anencephaly
reason: Near-universal termination after prenatal detection makes the recorded rate a reduction signal rather than a recording signal.

label: Congenital diaphragmatic hernia
reason: Reliably detected prenatally with some termination; the recorded rate mixes both channels.

label: Omphalocele
reason: Frequently associated with a chromosomal abnormality and so shares the Down syndrome detection-and-termination channel directly.

label: Suspected chromosomal disorder other than Down syndrome
reason: Shares the Down syndrome prenatal-detection and termination channel directly and responds to the same NIPT rollout; it is a co-outcome rather than a control. Not populated in the current extract in any case.
